title: Student Privacy & Campus Surveillance Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Assess your privacy risks on campus. Evaluate surveillance exposure, digital tracking, and student data protection at your school.
description: Calculate your privacy risk score based on campus surveillance systems, digital monitoring practices, and student data collection policies. Get personalized recommendations to protect your educational privacy and understand your rights.

inputs.label: Campus Type
inputs.helpText: Different institution types have varying privacy regulations and surveillance practices

inputs.label: Security Cameras on Campus (estimate)
inputs.helpText: More cameras typically mean higher surveillance exposure

inputs.label: Digital Proctoring Usage
inputs.helpText: Digital proctoring software monitors webcam, microphone, and screen activity

inputs.label: Personal Device Monitoring
inputs.helpText: How much access does your school require to your personal devices?

inputs.label: Third-Party Data Sharing
inputs.helpText: Does your school share student data with third-party companies?

inputs.label: Privacy Policy Awareness
inputs.helpText: Your awareness of school privacy policies affects your protection level

inputs.label: Opt-Out Options Available
inputs.helpText: Can you opt out of non-essential data collection or monitoring?

inputs.label: Biometric Data Collection
inputs.helpText: Does your school collect fingerprints, facial recognition, or other biometric data?

outputFields.label: Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your overall privacy risk score from 0-100 (higher = more risk)

outputFields.label: Risk Level
outputFields.description: Your privacy risk category with actionable recommendations

outputFields.label: Key Vulnerabilities
outputFields.description: Number of significant privacy vulnerabilities identified

formula: const cameraRisk = { minimal: 10, moderate: 25, extensive: 40, pervasive: 60 }[inputs.cameraCount] || 25; const proctoringRisk = { never: 0, rarely: 10, sometimes: 20, frequently: 35, always: 50 }[inputs.digitalProctoring] || 20; const deviceRisk = { none: 0, 'wifi-only': 15, 'software-required': 35, 'full-access': 50 }[inputs.personalDevicePolicy] || 15; const sharingRisk = { minimal: 5, moderate: 20, extensive: 35, unknown: 25 }[inputs.dataSharing] || 25; const awarenessBonus = { unaware: 0, 'somewhat-aware': -5, 'well-informed': -15 }[inputs.privacyNotices] || -5; const optOutBonus = inputs.optOutOptions ? -10 : 0; const biometricRisk = inputs.biometricData ? 20 : 0; const campusMultiplier = { 'k12-public': 0.8, 'k12-private': 0.7, 'high-school': 0.8, 'community-college': 0.9, 'public-university': 1.0, 'private-university': 1.1 }[inputs.campusType] || 1.0; let baseScore = cameraRisk + proctoringRisk + deviceRisk + sharingRisk + biometricRisk; let adjustedScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (baseScore + awarenessBonus + optOutBonus) * campusMultiplier)); const vulnerabilities = [cameraRisk > 25, proctoringRisk > 20, deviceRisk > 15, sharingRisk > 20, biometricRisk > 0, !inputs.optOutOptions].filter(Boolean).length; const riskLevel = adjustedScore < 25 ? 'Low Risk' : adjustedScore < 50 ? 'Moderate Risk' : adjustedScore < 75 ? 'High Risk' : 'Critical Risk'; return { riskScore: Math.round(adjustedScore), riskLevel: riskLevel, vulnerabilityCount: vulnerabilities };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your student privacy risk by analyzing campus surveillance infrastructure, digital monitoring practices, data sharing policies, and your personal privacy awareness. The scoring system weighs factors like camera density, digital proctoring frequency, device monitoring requirements, and biometric data collection. Different institution types receive adjusted risk multipliers based on typical privacy regulations and practices.
tips: Read your school's privacy policy and student handbook to understand data collection practices
Use Incognito Browser when accessing personal accounts on school networks to limit tracking
Ask about opt-out options for non-essential data collection and monitoring programs
Be cautious about what personal information you share on school-provided platforms
Understand your rights under FERPA (for US students) or local privacy laws
Use a VPN when possible to encrypt your internet traffic on campus WiFi
Regularly review and limit permissions granted to school-required apps on your devices
Keep personal and academic digital activities separate when feasible

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Your school has relatively strong privacy protections with limited surveillance. Continue practicing good digital hygiene and stay informed about policy changes.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some privacy concerns exist but are manageable. Review your school's policies, use privacy tools like Incognito Browser, and consider opting out of non-essential programs.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy vulnerabilities detected. Take active steps to protect your data, use privacy-focused browsers and tools, and advocate for better student privacy policies.

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
interpretation.description: Extensive surveillance and data collection present serious privacy risks. Implement strong privacy measures, limit personal information sharing, and consider advocacy or legal consultation.
